sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sig(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))))
    return sorted(out)
b0=sig(current_frame)
r1=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':14}])
print("click:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact')})
b1=sig(current_frame)
print("click changed board:", b0!=b1)
r2=action(['LEFT'])
print("left:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact')})
b2=sig(current_frame)
print("left changed board:", b1!=b2)
if b1!=b2:
    for x,y in zip(b1,b2):
        if x!=y: print("moved:",x,"->",y)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
